subject: POC planning: success criteria, timeline, and final readout scheduling - Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Sara / Matt —

Thanks for a great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned heading into the trial: 

1) Success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: 95th ≤ 350ms for typical patient-note generation (avg 250 tokens)
- Cost: target inference unit cost ≤ $0.004 per generated 1k tokens during the POC
- Quality: F1 ≥ 0.87 on labeled test prompts provided by Acme (will share sample set)
- Reliability: ≤ 1% error rate and retries per 1k requests

2) Evaluation plan:
- Redwood provides a POC template + test harness (attached: redwood_poc_template.pdf)
- Acme to supply a 50-prompt evaluation set + acceptance labels by Oct 12
- Weekly syncs: Tue 11am PT starting Oct 13

3) Timeline / ownership:
- Oct 6–9: Redwood: environment prep & preliminary model selection (Marcus)
- Oct 12: Acme: deliver labeled sample prompts (Matt / Helen)
- Oct 13–23: POC execution (Marissa / Rishi)
- Oct 26: Final readout (exec-level) and go/no-go decision (Sara + Acme execs)

4) Next steps:
- Matt: confirm who will own the dataset delivery and access (SFTP or shared Drive)
- Sara: confirm exec readout attendee list and preferred times for week of Oct 26

Attachments: redwood_poc_template.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0142

From: Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Helen Cho <helen.cho@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligned. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We're OK with the proposed success criteria but would like to relax the cost target a touch during the pilot (can we set a soft target of $0.005 per 1k tokens?)
- I'll own dataset delivery. We can share via our secure SFTP (I'll send access by Oct 8). Helen will lead labeling and can commit to Oct 12 delivery of the 50 prompts.
- For the exec readout: Sara + myself + our Head of Product (TBD) will attend; Oct 26 in the morning PT is best. Can you hold 9–10am PT on Oct 26 for a tentative slot?

Also: any constraints on PII/data handling we should be aware of in the test harness?

Thanks,
Matt
Product Manager, Acme Health
matt.dunn@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>, Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Great — thanks Matt. Responding inline: 

> can we set a soft target of $0.005 per 1k tokens?
Yes, we can treat $0.005 as the soft target for the POC; we'll record actuals in the POC dashboard and flag if we exceed by more than 15%.

> any constraints on PII/data handling?
We will not store raw PII in our hosted logs for the POC. For the trial we recommend token-level redaction where possible. I'll loop in Rishi (CS/Integration) to confirm specifics and provide our minimal config for SFTP ingestion.

Action items updated: 
- Matt: SFTP details by Oct 8 (confirmed)
- Helen: labeled prompts by Oct 12
- Marcus: environment ready by Oct 9
- Rishi: provide SFTP ingestion doc + redaction config by Oct 9
- Marissa: schedule weekly sync + reserve Oct 26 9–10am PT provisional in Acme/readout calendar

Attachments: POC_success_criteria.xlsx

Cheers,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today's discovery call

Adding technical owner notes for the integration: 

- I'll provision a sandbox project in our Private VPC for the POC. Expect credentials + SFTP instructions by Oct 9 EOD.
- Data handling: we'll provide a redaction script and recommend hashing patient identifiers before upload. If Acme cannot transform upstream, we can perform token-level redaction on ingest but will need a signed data processing addendum (DPA) for demo data.
- Monitoring: we'll enable the POC dashboard that tracks latency, token counts, error rates, and cost estimate. Marcus will have access to dashboards for internal tracking.

Please confirm if Acme needs a temporary HIPAA data processing exception for the sandbox demo (Sara?), otherwise we'll assume de-identified test data.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 07:15:00 -0700
Subject: Scheduling: Final readout and exec decision (week of Oct 26)

Sara — following Marissa and Rishi's notes, we'd like to lock the final readout on Oct 26 9–10am PT. Proposed agenda (30–45 minutes):
- 5 min: quick POC objective recap
- 15 min: demo & live metrics (latency, cost, quality)
- 10 min: results vs success criteria + implications
- 10 min: decision & next steps (procurement / contracting owner)

If Oct 26 9–10am PT works for your execs, we'll send a calendar invite and a short readout deck beforehand. If your team prefers another slot that week, suggest two alternatives.

Thanks,
Marcus

From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>, Helen Cho <helen.cho@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Final readout and exec decision (week of Oct 26)

Thanks Marcus — Oct 26 9–10am PT works for our execs. We'll confirm Head of Product and our Procurement lead by Oct 16.

A couple procurement notes:
- We typically run a standard vendor review; if we proceed, expect a 2–3 week procurement window post go/no-go to complete contracts.
- We prefer DocuSign for signature; can you send a preliminary SOW + pricing sheet the week prior to the readout?

I'll confirm attendee list by Oct 16.

Best,
Sara

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Matt Dunn <matt.dunn@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmation: Oct 26 9–10am PT final readout + pre-read materials

Perfect — locking Oct 26 9–10am PT. Actions before the readout: 
- Redwood: send a 6-slide readout deck + preliminary SOW/pricing by Oct 22 (Marissa / Marcus)
- Acme: confirm attendee list and procurement lead by Oct 16 (Sara)
- Acme: deliver labeled 50 prompts by Oct 12 (Helen) — please confirm upload to the shared Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_acme-poc

Next contract step if go: we will send a DocuSign SOW and one-year dedicated capacity pricing estimate for procurement review (expected 2–3 week review window).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the trial.

Marissa
